name: friendly-reminder
description: A friendly reminder after every response of the water it took, plus energy, tokens, API cost and subscription quota, with a daily and monthly history.

format.title: Output format
format.description: short: two lines, water first. table: a turn/month table. detailed: the table plus the token breakdown and the low-high estimate range. off: show nothing, keep the history.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system locale.

currency.title: Currency code
currency.description: Currency to show costs in, e.g. USD, BRL, EUR. Prices are in USD; set the exchange rate below for anything else.

exchange_rate.title: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: Units of your currency per 1 USD (e.g. 5.4 for BRL). Leave at 1 for USD.

footprint_profile.title: Footprint estimate
footprint_profile.description: Which water/energy estimate to show: central (default), or the low/high end of the published range.

water_scope.title: Water scope
water_scope.description: full: data-center cooling plus water used to generate the electricity. onsite: cooling only (what most vendor per-prompt figures report).
